method: Executed: real EntityTrackerEntry objects (hashCode = entity id, bytecode-read; equals compares ids) for real boats given ids by Entity.setEntityId, added to and removed from a real java.util.HashSet, the iteration order recorded after every operation. Bytecode-read: EntityTracker.c is `new HashSet()`, trackEntity adds, untrackEntity removes, updateTrackedEntities iterates it (twice). The order is the running JDK HashMap order (javaVersion); Java 7 differs and is not executed.
